signal.name: announced-workload-pressure
signal.measured: May31 at month end of the origin year
signal.available: June03 at 23:59:59.999Z of the origin year
signal.interpretation: An invented aggregate leading indicator with an explicitly imposed association, not a verified real workload measure or a future outcome proxy constructed from labels.

assignment.draw: One independent-by-design uniform per seed, after signal generation and before generating outcomes; shared across scenarios and groups

shock.rule: For each target-quarter day, after original scheduled company flows, draw binomial extra voluntary exits from remaining stock with probability 1-(1-.007)^(1/calendar-days-in-month). Reconcile stocks and person-days; never clip or reroll. Preserve pre-target vintages. Group allocation may change after extra events.

models.signal: recent-mean-3 plus training mean residual separately for signal 0 and 1; two fixed cell means, no tuning
models.clip: Clamp adjusted total predictions at zero, without rounding
models.fitCustody: Freeze fitted models and training evidence in a separate commit before generating any test seed. Each fit sees only its own scenario and training rows with labels available by training.labelsAsOf, before test.origin.

hypotheses.informative: Observable signal adjustment reduces held-out count MAE versus intercept-only and both original baselines under the declared stable association
hypotheses.noSignal: Without imposed signal association, additional cell means need not improve and can worsen error
hypotheses.reversed: A reversed signal relationship can erase or reverse any informative benefit
hypotheses.primaryDescriptiveCriterion: For each of groups A and B separately, at least 10% lower MAE than intercept-only and both original baselines in informative test histories. This is a descriptive synthetic criterion, never an operational gate or significance test.

controls: No-signal scenario, separately trained on no-signal histories
Reversed test relationship, using informative trained model without retraining
Signal release delayed until July01: forecast must equal intercept-only correction exactly
Future outcome mutation must leave pre-origin feature and point forecasts unchanged
Unexpected target, assignment, seed, truth or shock fields in feature records reject; future-effective or late-available records cannot be selected

evaluation.unit: 100 test company histories per scenario, shared across groups and scenarios; no pooling them as independent units
metrics: paired absolute-error delta versus each comparator
evaluation.pairedSupport: Compare methods only on common scored histories and show missing support explicitly
evaluation.intervals: No new prediction or metric confidence intervals; no calibration or promotion
evaluation.failurePolicy: Retain every frozen seed and failed invariant; no rerolls, tuning, favorable subset selection, extra features or follow-on heuristic experiments.

inputBoundary: Strict offline-only synthetic signal record plus existing validated aggregate release snapshot; model never receives seed, scenario, assignment, shock schedule, true probability or future outcome. Production inputs and consumers are unchanged.
privacy: Unchanged group allocation, minimum headcount 50, minimum positive exits 5 and complementary suppression. Suppressed groups remain unavailable and their actual totals are not emitted in score artifacts.
reservedQuarter: No October–December workforce outcomes generated or scored; labelsAsOf is a retrospective availability cutoff, not an outcome window.
limitations: The signal-outcome association and its stability are imposed, not discovered real evidence
PRNG domain separation is a design implementation, not statistical or cryptographic proof of independence
Training and test histories are different simulated companies and different calendar origins; this is not a claim of real-company transfer
No causal intervention, rates, person-level risk or real-world accuracy
Prior negative evidence, consumers, UI, database, security and held eNPS files remain unchanged
